relevance_note: Systematic review of ALPS-like disorders that reports TNFAIP3 patients only as counts and as one pooled gene column ("| **AI**  ... **TNFAIP3** | 25 | 105 | 8 | 16" in Supplementary table 1; Table 1 TNFAIP3 column), with no individual-level detail for any TNFAIP3 carrier.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown, including the converted supplementary DataSheet_1.docx. TNFAIP3 appears only in group form: Supplementary table 1 (25 publications, 105 reported cases, 8 filtered publications, 16 filtered ALPS-like cases), the pooled TNFAIP3 column of Table 1 (features summarised per gene, not per person), and in-text citations of literature (refs 61, 62, 85). The flow-cytometry figures show patients with other genes, none with TNFAIP3. No in-scope person, so only the publications row is filled. n_patients_reported is set to the 16 filtered TNFAIP3 cases whose data the authors collected; 105 is the number of TNFAIP3 cases counted before filtering. cohort_size_as_stated = 645 filtered ALPS-like patients (2245 unique patients were counted before filtering). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true because every patient comes from earlier publications (review); TNFAIP3-specific references are not separated in Supplementary table 2. No contradictions noted.
